_howToAdd: A pair is added only when it passes every check below. A pair that fails one is fixed or left out, never added with a note to confirm later (November 26: Elijah's first five went in with their problems written down as questions, and none passed).

A. Source: the job's own photos in Drive "05 Photos by Job Type" (one folder per job: it gives the service and the date). A pair from "02 Selects" or "03 Website" is a suggestion, not a check: three of the first five from there paired two different spots.

B. Same car, same spot, same side. Check the fixed parts (pedals, buckles, seat controls, floor anchors, rails, trim): a driver's floor is not the passenger's, and one captain's chair is not the other. A seat or mat can move between visits; the car's fixed parts can't.

C. About the same angle, then aligned: crop, rotate and scale the after onto the before so the subject sits at the same place and size, and cut both to the card's frame (.ba-stage aspect-ratio in styles.css, 4:3), at the same pixel size. A shot from another side or height that no crop can match is rejected.

D. Obvious contrast at card size (about 340 px wide): heavy staining, dirt, sand or grime in the before, clean in the after (Elijah, November 26). A before that is only a bit dusty, or an after still wet or patchy, is below the bar. If you have to hunt for the difference, so will a visitor.

E. Nothing personal in either crop: no plates (cars in the background too), faces, house numbers, door-jamb labels (they carry the VIN), papers, mail, bags, child seats or other belongings. Crop them out or reject the pair.

F. True to the job: services tags only what the job folder says was booked (leave it empty when that isn't known); the caption says what was done, with no removal promises ("100%", "removes 90%") and no em-dashes in the caption or alt text.
G. Judge the pair as the site shows it (the 760 files side by side), not the originals: the card crops anything that isn't its frame.
1. Masters: images/ba-<slug>-before.jpg and images/ba-<slug>-after.jpg, 1400x1050, saved fresh so no EXIF or GPS goes with them.
2. Resized: images/ba-<slug>-<side>-<width>.webp for each width in `widths`, plus ba-<slug>-<side>-760.jpg, each under 150 KB. The page never loads the full
size original: a phone would be pulling a megabyte per card.
3. Add an entry below with that same <slug>, a caption, alt text and `source` (job folder and photo names).
4. Optional: set video to a clip URL. Nothing renders one yet, but the
field is here so adding them later is a data change, not a code change.
5. Optional: tag with a service id so the gallery can filter by package.

6. Set "reviewed": false on a new pair until the owner has checked it against A to G; then true, or delete the field. Previews show it; any other build fails while one is false. The frame in C is also checked by web/lib/funnel.smoke.test.mjs (same size before and after, in the card's aspect ratio).
